result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: restaurant names are truncated without ellipsis in the Fastest near you carousel, and a pizza card appears without a restaurant name or metadata while neighboring cards have full labels.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or wrapping, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card titles with text overflow ellipsis, allow 2-line wrapping, or widen cards so full names remain visible.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card shows only a '-20%' badge and heart icon with no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or category—unlike the ramen card above it—making the listing incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add the restaurant name and standard metadata (time, delivery fee, cuisine, rating) below the image, consistent with other restaurant cards.
